name: System Monitor
author: binoymanoj
description: System monitoring bar widget for Omarchy displaying live CPU, RAM, and Network status with popup configuration

barWidget.description: Live CPU usage %, RAM %, Storage %, and Network speed on the topbar with detailed stats and configurable popup

schema.label: Show CPU on topbar
schema.description: Display CPU utilization percentage on the bar.

schema.label: Show RAM on topbar
schema.description: Display RAM utilization percentage on the bar.

schema.label: Show Storage on topbar
schema.description: Display internal storage utilization percentage on the bar.

schema.label: Show External Storage on topbar
schema.description: Display external drive indicator/usage on the bar when attached.

schema.label: Show Download Speed on topbar
schema.description: Display current network download rate on the bar.

schema.label: Show Upload Speed on topbar
schema.description: Display current network upload rate on the bar.

schema.label: Show icons on topbar
schema.description: Display metric icons beside the values on the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: How frequently system statistics are updated.
